_about: For every building with floor plans: ground, the level at street level (where its main entrance is), and order, its levels from the lowest (as in data/floors/<b>.json's levels). scripts/make_floors.py copies both into static/map/floors/index.json (order cut down to the levels it built); the floor view uses them to switch buildings on the matching level (lib.js matchLevel). Only HG's ground is confirmed by entrances marked main in the floor data; the rest follow ETH's convention (E is the ground floor), MM's is the plan's. The campus is on a slope, so a building's street level can be another's first floor (CLA D is LEE F): the links in data/floors/<b>.json with an explicit level win over this. Check the uncertain ones on site (plans/REVAMP_2_DECISIONS.md).
